description: Unit test class for TimeoutValueValidator, testing various validation scenarios for timeout header values.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes validDittoDurationString before all tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that TimeoutValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null header definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that accepting null value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateDittoDuration
methods.description: Verifies that the validator can validate DittoDuration class types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures that a valid DittoDuration string is accepted without exception.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotDittoDuration
methods.description: Ensures that non-DittoDuration types are not validated.

methods.name: acceptNonDittoDurationString
methods.description: Tests rejection of invalid DittoDuration string (e.g., 'true').

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithNegativeAmount
methods.description: Tests rejection of negative duration strings.

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithInvalidTimeUnit
methods.description: Tests rejection of duration strings with unsupported units (e.g., hours).
